y-axis tick fit: maximum residual of the four labelled ticks
y-axis LEAVE-ONE-OUT residuals. calibrate's max-residual test is weak against a single bad tick -- an end tick has leverage 0.2, so four fifths of its error is absorbed into the fit.

THE UNPRINTED ROUND NUMBER. The y axis carries four MINOR ticks that bear no label and were excluded from the fit: the scale is set only by the four long, labelled ticks. Predicting the minor ticks' values is therefore external to the calibration in the way a recomputed marginal is not. They should land on 15, 45, 75 and 105.

what_the_automated_checks_CANNOT_see: CONNECTIVITY. Every mass check above passes on any isomer. The regiochemistry is settled by P10a's enumeration (there is only one constitution) and by the synthesis the paper describes, not by any mass.

STEREOCHEMISTRY, twice over. (i) The cyclic benzylidene acetal has a C2/C5 cis-trans relationship that the paper never draws and never discusses, and the stored SMILES is flat. (ii) WORSE: assemble.stereocentres(), which is what assemble.attach's check_stereo_preserved relies on, returns {} for this tail, while Chem.FindPotentialStereo returns two unspecified centres. The library's stereo guard is blind to the one stereochemical feature this paper's chemistry turns on, so its passing is not evidence here. DECISIONS.md D-2.

WHETHER THE X-AXIS LABELS WERE READ CORRECTLY. The group order is read off a 1050 px raster by eye. P4/P5/P7/P8 constrain it hard -- five groups are identified by name in the prose and the remaining order is pinned by eleven sign statements -- but no check reads the glyphs.
WHETHER FIGURE 5 IS THE SAME DATA AS THE PROSE. If the authors typed a number that their own figure does not show, every check here would split rather than agree, which is exactly what P6b does.
